question: Team TS3006 planned both an LCD screen and speech recognition. When the costs forced a cut, which of the two did they drop, which did they keep, and what reason was given for keeping it?
answer: They dropped speech recognition and kept the LCD screen; they said losing the screen would mean needing many extra buttons, and Speaker C (Industrial Designer) added that speech had not really been integrated. Earlier, they had planned to include both features. citeTS3006bTS3006d
